text:
claire_finance: Quick sync - finance wants to run a targeted pricing experiment for token gen + embeddings. Objective: test commitment discounts vs usage-credit mechanic and measure net revenue + churn. Need ops/product/sales signoff and a rollout checklist.
noah_product: Can you paste the experiment arms and the rollout window here?
claire_finance: Sure. Arms: A = 12% discount for customers that accept a 3-month prepay (promo PREPAY12). B = monthly usage-credit equal to 8% of bill (line item 'Usage credit'). Holdout = 10% of eligible keep current prices. Duration: 7 weeks. Allocation: 30% treatment (A/B split), 10% holdout, rest control.
harper_sales: Sales note: exclude enterprise accounts with custom billing or active SOWs. For renewals >$125k, keep existing pricing until contract end. I'll share the list.
raj_ops: Ops questions: can billing represent the credit as invoice line and can we set per-customer grandfather flags? @billing-bot please confirm API support.
billing-bot: automated msg - Billing API supports promo codes and invoice_line_label overrides. Per-customer metadata field metadata.grandfather_until (ISO date) supported. Endpoints: POST /promos, PATCH /customers/{id}. Docs: https://billing.internal/api#promos
claire_finance: Sample CSV to import to staging pricing table:
```plan,segment,old_price_per_1k,new_price_per_1k,notes
hosted-gen,small,0.34,0.34,control
hosted-gen,mid,0.29,0.255,treatment-A prepay12
hosted-embed,all,0.055,0.0594,treatment-B usage-credit
```
noah_product: Metrics & stop rules: primary = net revenue per customer cohort; secondary = 30-day churn, refund rate, and invoice disputes. Stop if churn in any treatment > 1.7x baseline or if revenue delta < -3% after 2 full weeks. We'll build dashboards.
harper_sales: Communication: need a customer-facing FAQ and an email template for SMBs. Also an opt-in promo code flow via billing portal for SMBs is ideal.
raj_ops: Ops checklist: 1) import pricing CSV to staging 2) create promos in staging 3) tag experiment cohorts in customer metadata 4) set grandfather_until for any opted-out customers 5) update invoice template to show 'Usage credit' or 'Prepay discount' 6) run sandbox E2E smoke test and accounting export.
claire_finance: We also want manual opt-outs for enterprise - set metadata.grandfather_until to their contract end or 9999-12-31 on request. For active negotiations, ops should exclude customers where deal_stage != 'closed_won'.
noah_product: I'll own the A/B analytics dashboard and alerting. Please add alert hooks to #incidents if stop criteria hit.
harper_sales: +1 from sales pending account list. Will prepare talking points and escalate to legal if any MSA tweaks needed.
raj_ops: +1 from ops. Scheduling sandbox test tomorrow 8:30am PT, job id staging_x12. I'll post results here.
claire_finance: +1 from finance. Plan to start with a 5% pilot cohort on Mon (1732080000) after sandbox verification, then ramp to target split over 2 weeks if safe.
billing-bot: deployment log - promos created in staging at 1732003200; promo ids: PROMO_PREPAY12_STG, PROMO_USAGE_STG.
noah_product: small ask: add an experiment label to invoices so accounting can filter exports (invoice.metadata.experiment = 'prepay_vs_credit').
raj_ops: good call - we'll add that tag. Also will create a support KB snippet explaining how usage credits appear on invoices.
harper_sales: For customers who opt in via sales, mark their customer record with metadata.pricing_opt_in = 'sales' so they don't get auto-cohorted.
claire_finance: Thanks all. I'll open the PR with CSV + rollout doc and post the link here. If no objections by EOD we'll move promos to prod next Monday and start pilot. :rocket:
